text:
Jordan: quick thought 1 want us to stop lumping fp8/int8/4bit into a single 'lowbit' metric. it's hiding mode-specific regressions.
Mei: agree. what minimal telemetry do we need to make the cohorts actionable?
Jordan: per-request: model, quant_profile, precision_lane, rollout_id, token_count, avg_token_conf, low_conf_token_count, degradation_score, sample_bucket. plus a 3-bin tail severity histogram.
Vik: +1 but cost is real. don't store per-token probs by default. do compact summaries and only collect full traces on anomalies or canaries (1% sampling otherwise).
Anya: for detection you mostly need aggregates. summary proto should include avg_conf, tail_entropy_est, and num_low_conf_tokens. full traces are for triage only.
Jordan: runtime vs post-process: runtime scoring lets us trigger immediate dumps but touches hotpath. post-process is safer to ship first.
Vik: initial rollout = emit summary only from serving. analytics computes degradation_score and can request full-trace exports if needed. later we can add a tiny runtime gate.
Mei: label/schema proposal: `quant_profile` (string), `precision_lane` (enum: fp8,int8,4bit,fp16), `rollout_id`, `sample_bucket` (prod/shadow/canary). retention: summaries 90d, full-traces 7d unless triaged.
Anya: security: full-traces can contain PII. require a PII redaction pipeline before persistent storage. flag metadata `pii_filtered=true/false` and block extended retention without sec approval. encrypt full-traces and restrict KMS access.
ingest-bot: deploy note: canary `qpath-exp-13` healthy, 99.97% latency SLO met.
Vik: proto sketch (extensible - use proto2):
```
string request_id
string model
string quant_profile
string precision_lane
string rollout_id
int32 token_count
float avg_token_conf
float degradation_score
map<string,float> extra_metrics
```
Mei: add `sample_bucket` and `prompt_len_bucket` fields. and `schema_version` for migrations.
Jordan: dashboards: cohort matrix (precision_lane x quant_profile) with trend lines for degradation_score, avg_conf, and cost/token. filters for rollout_id and sample_bucket.
Anya: alerting: cohort-level anomaly when degradation_score increases > 3 std over 24h or absolute > 0.5 for >1h. page eng-oncall + model-owner, include link to sampled full-trace.
Vik: infra note: I'll prototype Kinesis -> clickhouse ingestion and a small consumer to compute degradation_score and headwise deltas offline.
Mei: ops ask: include a retrospective job that computes per-head deltas for flagged requests to speed up model debugging.
Jordan: plan: Phase 1 = no runtime scoring: emit summaries + analytics pipeline + dashboards + alerts. Phase 2 = optional runtime gating to request full-traces when analytics flags borderline anomalies.
Mei: I'll write a short RFC + rough cost estimate. cc @vik @anya for proto & security review.
Vik: will open proto PR and a tiny POC ingestion job.
Anya: security will validate PII filter and retention - recommend auto-redact by default.
Jordan: sync tomorrow 10:30am for 20m to assign owners? :thumbsup:
Mei: SG.
